description: This file defines the public APIs, data structures, enums, macros, and function prototypes for DMA (Direct Memory Access) driver interfaces in the Zephyr RTOS. It includes DMA channel configurations, transfer modes, callback mechanisms, and device attribute retrieval functions.

methods.name: dma_config
methods.description: Configures an individual DMA channel with specified parameters.

methods.name: dma_reload
methods.description: Reloads source and destination addresses for a DMA transfer on a specific channel.

methods.name: dma_start
methods.description: Starts the DMA transfer on a specified channel.

methods.name: dma_stop
methods.description: Stops the DMA transfer on a specified channel.

methods.name: dma_suspend
methods.description: Suspends an ongoing DMA transfer on a channel.

methods.name: dma_request_channel
methods.description: Requests a DMA channel based on a filter.

methods.name: dma_release_channel
methods.description: Releases a previously acquired DMA channel.

methods.name: dma_chan_filter
methods.description: Filters DMA channels based on attributes.

methods.name: dma_get_status
methods.description: Retrieves the current runtime status of a DMA transfer.

methods.name: dma_get_attribute
methods.description: Gets specific static or runtime attributes of a DMA controller.

methods.name: dma_width_index
methods.description: Returns a register-compatible index for a given bus width.

methods.name: dma_burst_index
methods.description: Returns a register-compatible index for a given burst length.
